name: Salinas de Pisuerga (Spain)
description: Yellow triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly bearing the crowned municipal arms of Salinas de Pisuerga (a bull and salt pans on yellow above waves), the upper triangle blue and the lower green.
history: Municipal flag of Salinas de Pisuerga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: upper triangle from the upper hoist to the fly
lower triangle from the lower hoist to the fly
Salinas de Pisuerga arms — bull and salt pans on yellow above waves
cap of the crown of the arms
